Name: session-cost
Version: 1.0.5

The session-cost skill is a legitimate utility designed to analyze local OpenClaw session logs for token usage and cost reporting. The primary script, scripts/session-cost.js, uses standard Node.js modules to read and aggregate data from .jsonl files within the ~/.openclaw/agents/ directory, with no evidence of network exfiltration, unauthorized file access, or malicious execution patterns.
